# Femi Orimoloye — Digital Authority Reference

## Identity and positioning
Femi Orimoloye (formal name shown in professional source material: Orimoloye Oluwafemi) is positioned as a strategic human-capital and people-strategy professional. The brand connects people strategy, talent, total rewards, employee experience and organisational effectiveness to organisational performance and business outcomes.

Official tagline: People Strategy. Organizational Performance. Lasting Impact.

## Supported professional areas
- Human-capital leadership and strategic HR business partnering
- Total rewards, compensation and benefits, job evaluation and pay equity
- Workforce planning, talent acquisition, leadership development and succession
- Employee engagement, experience, inclusion and culture initiatives
- HR operations, shared services, process improvement and systems
- Programme development, mentorship and onboarding

## Career contexts in supplied profile
- Head, Program Development, Empowered Futures (June 2025–present in supplied profile)
- HR Program Consultant, PRUDE Inc. (February 2025–present in supplied profile)
- Head, Human Capital Management & Total Rewards, Nigeria Inter-Bank Settlement Systems PLC (February 2022–November 2024)
- Manager, Reward & Shared Services, Interswitch Group (January 2020–January 2022)
- Senior Strategic HR Business Partner, Access Bank Plc (October 2018–December 2019)

## Selected reported outcomes from supplied profile
- Cross-border compensation and benefits harmonisation across seven countries and 300+ roles at Interswitch; profile reports a 23% improvement in internal pay equity.
- Digital mentorship programme at Empowered Futures; profile reports 95% participant engagement and 90% programme completion in the first cycle.
- Graduate trainee programme at NIBSS; profile reports 100% retention.
- Leadership framework at NIBSS; profile reports a 12% improvement in managerial effectiveness.
- Shared-services efficiency and HR policy harmonisation; profile reports an 86% increase in efficiency.

These metrics are presented as profile-reported outcomes, not independently audited claims. Validate with the brand owner before publication.
